personas.objective: Grow her capital over the long term
personas.preferences_text: Very interested in artificial intelligence and emerging technologies. Open to high-growth companies and significant volatility; interested in crypto assets.
personas.constraints_text: Still wants some diversification and does not want to invest exclusively in technology.

personas.objective: Grow his capital in a balanced way over the medium to long term
personas.preferences_text: Places high importance on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors. Seeks a balance between growth potential and stability. Is open to emerging technologies when they fit his risk profile.
personas.constraints_text: Wants to avoid companies involved in significant environmental or social controversies. Has little interest in highly speculative investments.
